concept.title: Scenes and Sources
concept.shortdesc: How OBS Studio's scene and source model works.

conbody.p: OBS Studio supports eleven source types, covering screen and window capture, game capture, camera and audio devices, images, media files, browser content, text, solid color, slideshows, and VLC-based playlists. Each source type has its own properties dialog with settings specific to that source.

Sources can be resized, cropped, and layered within a scene using the same transform handles regardless of source type, and the same source can be reused across multiple scenes without duplicating its underlying capture.
